chunks: One pig started a war between Britain and America.
San Juan Island sits between Vancouver Island and the mainland:
In 1846 the two countries agreed a border down the middle of the channel.
So for thirteen years both countries owned the island on paper,
In 1853 the Hudson's Bay Company landed thirteen hundred sheep and called the place Belle Vue.
Six years later there were four thousand,
and forty hogs that went wherever they liked.

Cutlar had already asked Charles Griffin to keep his hogs off the land.
This time he had had enough.

So the settlers asked their army to come.
Britain sent five warships and two thousand men.
The two sides stood facing each other,

For twelve years British and American soldiers shared the island:
In 1872 a German emperor drew the line,
and the Americans kept the island.
